scripts.build:zig: zig build-exe experiments/zig/registry.zig -target wasm32-freestanding -O ReleaseSmall -fno-entry -rdynamic -femit-bin=experiments/zig/registry.wasm && esbuild experiments/zig/browser.js --bundle --minify --loader:.wasm=binary --outfile=dist/webmcp-zig.min.js
scripts.build:rust: rustc experiments/rust/registry.rs --edition=2021 --crate-type=cdylib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -C opt-level=z -C lto -C panic=abort -C strip=symbols -o experiments/rust/registry.wasm && esbuild experiments/rust/browser.js --bundle --minify --loader:.wasm=binary --outfile=dist/webmcp-rust.min.js
